event_properties.content: Which dish is getting the most praise?

The **Butter Chicken** is your most praised dish this month — mentioned positively in 67 reviews. Close second is **Garlic Naan** (52 mentions). Customers frequently pair these two in their positive comments.
Show me my average rating this month
Your average rating this month is **3.8 ★** across all platforms. Zomato: 3.9, Swiggy: 3.6, Google: 4.1. Compared to last month (3.7), you're up by 0.1 points overall.
What are customers complaining about the most?

Across all locations, the top complaints are: **1) Long wait times** (38% of negative feedback), **2) Cold food on delivery** (22%), and **3) Rude staff** (17%). Dine-in complaints spike on weekends, delivery complaints are consistent through the week.
How many 1-star reviews did I get this week?

You received **8 one-star reviews** this week — 5 on Zomato, 2 on Swiggy, and 1 on Google. I've flagged the top 3 most detailed ones for your review. Would you like me to draft response templates for them?
How many reviews did I get from koramangala through Google in April?

I don't have data for April in this dataset. The reviews I'm seeing are from late April through early May 2026 (April 27 - May 8). For **Chianti, Koramangala** specifically, I can see 11 reviews from **Google My Business** during this period, but I can't isolate just the April portion since most reviews fall in May.

🎯 **Your Biggest Opportunity**
**Vayu by Shankar Bhavan** has a strong 4.0 rating and amazing ambience that customers love — but 1 in 4 reviews mention food quality issues that are keeping people from coming back or recommending you.

⚠️ **What's Holding You Back**
Many guests felt let down by inconsistent food — stale chicken, undercooked dishes, and overly salty or sour preparations were recurring themes. Your beautiful setting gets them in the door, but food problems stop them from returning or bringing friends.

✅ **3 Actions to Drive More Footfalls**
First, audit your kitchen on **Tuesdays** and **Sundays** (your worst-rated days) to catch quality issues before service. Second, retrain staff on freshness checks for chicken and seafood — several customers mentioned spoiled meat. Third, leverage your 75% positive reviews by asking happy customers to share their experience on social media and tag your location — word-of-mouth from your satisfied diners (who loved the ambience and service) w
Which specific dishes are getting the most complaints?

🍽️ **Most Complained Dishes**
Customers flagged **chicken popcorn**, **prawn tempura**, **hakka noodles**, and **mocktails** most often. Around 1 in 3 complaints mentioned chicken dishes specifically.

⚠️ **Core Problems**
Many guests felt the chicken tasted stale or smelled off, with some noting it was undercooked or using spoiled ingredients. Prawn tempura received mixed feedback, while mocktails were described as watery (half-filled with ice) and poorly balanced. Mushroom curry also drew complaints for tasting sour and smelling unpleasant.

✅ **Immediate Action**
Conduct a full ingredient freshness audit, especially for chicken and seafood. Review prep and storage protocols with your kitchen team, and consider removing or reformulating the mocktails until quality improves.

🔴 **Your Main Challenge**
All 6 complaints this week centered on food quality — customers felt dishes were tasteless, undercooked, or poorly executed. Service speed and staff attentiveness came up in half of these reviews.

🍽️ **What Customers Noticed**
Guests flagged specific issues like hard garlic naan, overly salty noodles, sour mushroom curry, and fish that didn't taste fresh. Many felt the food didn't match the pricing or the beautiful ambience you've created.

✅ **Quick Win**
Run a kitchen audit this week focusing on seasoning consistency, cooking times, and ingredient freshness — especially for paneer, fish, and curries.
